svg.title: STC-01 · Twenty themes. One stage.
svg.desc: Masthead for the Stagehand Theme Codex. Twenty motion themes in five families, each tile showing its codename, five-color palette, home register and B2B fit. Counts: 20 themes, 5 families, 3 intensity levels, 5 web slots, 1 sample dataset, 0 outside requests.
svg.text: REF STC V1.0 / REEL V6 · FIG STC-01
Motion themes that page, reel and deck agents can wear, at three volumes.
Inspired by genres, never copied from them. Public copy
uses codenames only, and every number on screen is a
BHIL · STAGEHAND THEME CODEX · FIG STC-01
